pages.headline: 8' Big chance - Celtic
pages.caption: Johnny Kenny (Celtic) hits the left post with a right footed shot from the left side of the box. Assisted by Luke McCowan.

pages.headline: 9' GOAL - Celtic 1-0 Kilmarnock
pages.caption: Johnny Kenny (Celtic) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Reo Hatate. Celtic 1-0 Kilmarnock.
pages.explanation: Goal at 9' made it Celtic 1-0 Kilmarnock.

pages.headline: 26' Big chance - Celtic
pages.caption: Attempt saved. Sebastian Tounekti (Celtic) right footed shot from outside the box is saved in the bottom left corner by Eddie Beach (Kilmarnock). Assisted by Reo Hatate.

pages.headline: 26' Big chance - Celtic
pages.caption: Attempt saved. Johnny Kenny (Celtic) left footed shot from very close range is saved in the centre of the goal by Eddie Beach (Kilmarnock).

pages.headline: 28' Big chance - Kilmarnock
pages.caption: Bruce Anderson (Kilmarnock) hits the left post with a left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box. Assisted by Eddie Beach following a set piece situation.

pages.headline: 50' GOAL - Celtic 2-0 Kilmarnock
pages.caption: Kieran Tierney (Celtic) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Liam Scales. Celtic 2-0 Kilmarnock.
pages.explanation: Goal at 50' made it Celtic 2-0 Kilmarnock.

pages.headline: 84' GOAL - Celtic 3-0 Kilmarnock
pages.caption: Daizen Maeda (Celtic) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Arne Engels with a through ball. Celtic 3-0 Kilmarnock.
pages.explanation: Goal at 84' made it Celtic 3-0 Kilmarnock.

pages.headline: 91' Penalty decision
pages.caption: Penalty conceded by James Brown (Kilmarnock) after a foul in the penalty area.

pages.headline: 91' Penalty awarded
pages.caption: Penalty Celtic. Yang Hyun-Jun draws a foul in the penalty area.

pages.headline: 92' PENALTY GOAL - Celtic 4-0 Kilmarnock
pages.caption: Arne Engels (Celtic) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner. Celtic 4-0 Kilmarnock.
pages.explanation: Goal at 92' made it Celtic 4-0 Kilmarnock.
